criteria: Actual NodeScriptRunner launches Node and EventedStreamReader delivers colored stderr including CRLF, LF, whitespace, and final unterminated line; no injected OnReceivedLine callbacks.
Real LoggerFactory threshold Information/Error preserves enabled normalized log payloads, levels, order per stream, whitespace suppression, and raw stderr capture.
Critical/None thresholds suppress attempted Error Log calls before normalization; identical focused assertions fail without guard and pass with guard for each disabled row.
Incomplete stderr chunk Console forwarding and independent error capture remain outside new guard; verify by focused producer scenario where practical.
No public API/default/convention changes; one conditional guard only in shipping source.
Existing native SpaServices.Extensions.Tests targeted tests plus native baseline controls run with private graph local SDK, max2 nodes, no shared compilation/node reuse.
excluded: Performance/materiality, elapsed/allocation/profiling/counters, all benchmarks and comparisons.
Angular/React CLI full installations or hosted application/browser workflow.
Forcing RegexMatchTimeoutException by enormous/time-dependent text; custom throwing/dynamic ILogger providers are source-characterized only.
